scope: Original MIT atlas algorithms copied into a new independent supplement; previous numerical source and all frozen editions remain unchanged. Theta integration, Cartesian/analytic references and kinetic/statistical diagnostics are independently implemented as described case by case. No third-party library source is bundled.
optional_plotting: Saved JSON only; Matplotlib is not required for numerical runs.
independence_limits: SPME real/self terms share primary Ewald but the full theta reference does not.
PIC DOP853 shares the particle-grid RHS and independently checks time integration only.
Radiation adaptive integration and exponential integrals use different algorithms in SciPy; the photon estimator is independently sampled.
DSMC compares analytic COM-sphere marginals and independent Gaussian-projection samples; correlated particles are not IID statistical replicates.
